paragraphs.source_en: “I’d rather, by half, have them swearing in my ears from morning to night, than listen to you whatsoever!” . . . “It’s a blazing shame, that I cannot open the blessed Book, without you setting up those glories to Satan, and all the terrible wickedness that ever was born into the world! Oh! you’re a right nothing; and she’s another; and that poor lad will be lost between you. Poor lad!” . . . “He’s bewitched: I’m certain of it. Oh, Lord, judge them, for there’s neither law nor justice among our rulers!”

paragraphs.source_en: “It’s not Nelly.” . . . .“I wouldn’t move for Nelly, nasty evil nothing that she is. Thank God! she cannot steal anybody’s soul! She was never so handsome, that a man might look at her without winking. It’s that terrible graceless queen that’s bewitched our lad with her bold eyes and forward ways—till—No! it fairly bursts my heart!”
